targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-1006 ran the three-leg sd_e1_var_bar_readout_crush portfolio (6 seeds, 4 arms, all GREEN) and discharged the question's recorded observation_bottleneck ('real-endpoint goal_proximity variance never recorded'). Leg A (H-fidelity-anchor) and Leg C (H-goal-orthogonal-dispersion) are UNANIMOUS 6/6 against their declared nulls and are adjudicable. Leg B (H-readout-saturation) is NOT: its declared null ('real-endpoint goal_proximity variance >= 0.002 on a majority of seeds') is MET on the from-reset (Phase 4b) endpoint set -- 6/6 seeds clear 0.002 -- and NOT met on the same-start (Phase 4d) set the driver adopted, where 4/6 fall below. The two admissible denominators invert the leg's verdict. The run's own dv_headroom_gate records the same fact from the other side (achievable 0.00107 vs required 0.002, ratio 0.54) and is deliberately non-gating. Read Leg B as denominator-contingent, not as 'the bar is unreachable'.

failure_location.net_classification: NOT A FAILURE -- an informative portfolio. Legs A and C are positive results at full power. Leg B is MEASURES-partial (denominator under-determination), not chargeable to REE.

learning_extracted: A bar registered before its DV's dynamic range is measured can be unreachable in one operationalisation and comfortably clearable in another. Leg B's 0.002 bar is cleared 6/6 on from-reset endpoints and missed 4/6 on same-start endpoints -- the SAME run, the SAME seeds, two defensible denominators.

The from-reset set is NOT a universal upper bound on the same-start set -- on seed7 the same-start variance EXCEEDS it (0.0239158 vs 0.0196255); it holds 5 of 6. The load-bearing argument is geometric, not empirical: at h=1, 40 rollouts from ONE start reach at most n_actions distinct endpoints, so the same-start set isolates rollout-attributable variance while the from-reset set adds start dispersion. Both denominators are recorded in this manifest, so settling Leg B needs NO new run -- it is `complex (probe-gated) / mystery (known data)`.

Making the classification criteria load_bearing:false (C1-C5) and gating PASS on C0 (any arm green) alone is a deliberate and effective answer to a prior vacuous_pass; the leg readings carry the science and the gate carries only readiness.

ASYMMETRY to surface with the Leg-B decision: the manifest's own interpretation.branched_same_start_note says 'the registered legs read Phase 4b so this run stays comparable with 1000', yet the same-start substitution was applied to Leg B ONLY. Leg C still reads Phase 4b. Leg B is also the only leg whose verdict the switch changes. Checked and NOT results-driven -- on the same-start denominator Leg C still reads rsd_goal_orthogonal (5 below / 1 above) -- but the asymmetry is unexplained and belongs in the governance decision.

targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-1009 is the 2x2 spike commissioned after V3-EXQ-1005 was refused at red-team, to separate two candidate causes of the elite-selection ceiling (untrained E2 action-object head vs the support-preserving ao_std floor). It discriminated NEITHER. Argued on C1's OWN statistic (projected_lineage_increment), no cell came close to the pre-registered 0.02 floor: shortfall factors 43.03 / 2.31 / 8.69 / 4.72, with FROZEN/floor0.0 the MARGINAL cell at 2.31x short. Do NOT state this as 'unreachable by construction', and do NOT quote the 0.9973 headroom figure as C1 headroom: dv_headroom.headroom_ratio_by_cell is computed on delta_dbar rather than on the statistic C1 gates, and the manifest's own red_team_dispositions_iter3 records that the oracle is GREEDY, not an argmax over all C(16,3)=560 elite subsets, so the measured ceiling is a LOWER bound on the true oracle ceiling. The defensible claim is bounded and still decisive: at THIS oracle's strength the elite-selection channel does not come within 2.3x of the floor on any of four benches, and the oracle directly optimises the axis the DV measures, so a real mode-conditioned arm is very unlikely to do better. The self-routed label 'elite_channel_ceiling_confirmed_all_benches' over-reads and must NOT be applied as a confirmed bench-independent ceiling; the driver's own what_a_null_does_not_mean already states the correct narrower reading. The defensible finding is that the proposal-output centroid is the wrong readout for MECH-267's content assertion -- consistent with, and adding nothing to, the already-CLOSED mech267_content_persistence_cem_refit question (5/5 legs adjudicated; locus confirmed as shared CEM elite-refit breadth). The outcome PASS is a driver convention (PASS in 3 of 4 branches; only a readiness failure yields FAIL), so the indexer's vacuous_pass flag is mechanically correct and should be read as 'informative null on an under-ranged DV', not as a degenerate result.

failure_record_entry.metric: READOUT EXHAUSTION, recorded so no future session re-attempts it. Argued on C1's own statistic (projected_lineage_increment): shortfall_factor_vs_floor = 43.03 FROZEN/floor0.2, 2.31 FROZEN/floor0.0, 8.69 GROUNDED/floor0.2, 4.72 GROUNDED/floor0.0 against the pre-registered 0.02 floor. The MARGINAL cell is FROZEN/floor0.0 at 2.31x short -- no cell is near-clearing. (Do NOT read custom_information.dv_headroom's 0.9973 for GROUNDED/floor0.2 as near-clearing: that ratio is on delta_dbar, and that cell is 8.69x short on the statistic C1 actually gates.) An ORACLE elite re-ranker that directly optimises the measured axis produced this; the oracle is greedy, so its ceiling is a LOWER bound on the true oracle ceiling and 'impossible' is NOT established -- but neither grounding E2's action-object head into genuine action-dependence nor removing the support-preserving ao_std floor lifts it within 2.3x.

cluster_pattern.shape: Three of the four targets carry a pass bar in tension with their DV's achievable range, and the batch is a MIXED verdict on the dv_headroom convention rather than a clean sweep. V3-EXQ-1006 Leg B: a genuine, verified case (achievable 0.00107 vs required 0.002), correctly declared non-gating. V3-EXQ-1009 C1: the right verdict reached via the WRONG statistic -- headroom was computed on delta_dbar while C1 gates projected_lineage_increment, so the cell the headroom table makes look closest (GROUNDED/floor0.2, 0.9973) is actually 8.69x short and the true marginal cell (FROZEN/floor0.0, 2.31x) is never named. V3-EXQ-972a T3: a FALSE POSITIVE of the instrument -- its headroom entry used 1-MAX(control accuracy) while the test is on the MEAN, and two observed paired diffs exceeded the asserted ceiling. V3-EXQ-970a is the clean control: 8.7x/8.6x headroom and a decisive positive at p=0.0039.
cluster_pattern.structural_property: One clean catch, one right-for-the-wrong-reason, one false positive. The convention is deployed and valuable, but this batch does NOT show it working as designed -- two of its three firings were computed on a quantity other than the one the criterion gates. The sharpened, actionable rule is therefore stronger than 'measure headroom': a dv_headroom entry MUST be computed on the same STATISTIC and the same ORDER STATISTIC as the criterion it certifies. A cheap self-check follows from the 972a case: if any observed value of the test statistic exceeds the asserted ceiling, the ceiling is mis-specified.
